name: Stellenbosch and the Winelands
tagline: Oak-lined streets and wine estates under the mountains
summary: Stellenbosch is a Cape Dutch university town at the heart of South Africa's Winelands, with whitewashed gables and oak avenues. Taste wine on mountain estates, ride the Franschhoek Wine Tram, eat at world-class restaurants and day-trip to Paarl and Franschhoek.
seasonNote: Harvest season (February to April) is lively; winter is green and quiet.
arrival: 45 minutes' drive from Cape Town International.
gettingAround: Walk the town; drivers, tours or the wine tram for estates.
cashTip: Cards and tap-to-pay work almost everywhere; carry small rand notes for car guards and tips.
foodTip: Wine-pairing lunches and Cape Malay bobotie.
buyTip: Wine, olive oil and handmade ceramics.
